The Reality of an AI Tomorrow Rafael Salazar · 2026

We speak constantly about the future AI will create.

But sometimes the more important question is already in front of us:
What happens to the human being in the tomorrow we are building?

This photograph was not staged. It records a real moment encountered during Labor Day weekend.

The photograph is reality. AI is the question.
